questions.prompt: Simon defined learning as changes in a system that result in ___ over time on tasks similar to those done previously.

options: a change in human disposition or capacity
a change that persists over a period of time
a change not simply ascribable to processes of growth
re-examining experience in the light of one’s intent and existing knowledge
using helpful feelings and removing obstructive ones

questions.prompt: Which of the following assumptions does not come under the behaviorist orientation to learning?
options: Differences between individuals are important as they will affect learning
Observable behavior rather than internal thought processes are the focus of study.
The principle of contiguity is central
